notes: Israel Invoices (חשבוניות ישראל) allocation-number thresholds. An invoice above the threshold, before VAT, must carry a valid 9-digit allocation number from the Tax Authority or the RECIPIENT cannot deduct input VAT. Applies to domestic B2B only; B2C, B2G and cross-border are outside the mandate.
